profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced in full stack web development and user experience design.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Worked with the iPlant Collaborative to share biological data for high-throughput phenotyping
- Created a wiki-style web server where users can post and view each other's work
- Github repository: https://github.com/geordyp/Wiki-Server

- Developed a text editor which uses existing software to run analysis on water control structures
- Implemented syntax highlighting and contextual hover text
- Github repository: https://github.com/geordyp/Wildcat

positions.title: CIS 200 Programming Fundamentals Teaching Assistant
positions.description: - Assisted students in 3 lab sections with their java assignments

positions.title: CIS 115 Intro to Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Attended lectures and assist students with in-class work
- Graded weekly blog and programming assignments
- Held help sessions to assist students with homework assignments

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a tool which introduces new users to the key features of an application
- Conducted research on existing solutions and helped define the projects direction
- Developed the UI prototypes in Sketch which the implementation engineers used for guidance
- Helped develop the React.js front-end and wrote the controller between the front and back-end
- http://www.geordywilliams.com/projects/Visa/SummerProject.html

positions.title: User Experience Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Redesigned the home UI for their web app while adding the ability to rearrange app icons
- Developed various components of their web app’s UI in collaboration with designers
- Utilized frameworks such as Require.js, Less.js, Handlebars.js, and Node.js
- http://www.geordywilliams.com/projects/Lexmark/SummerProject.html

positions.title: R&D Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated effectively with our team of interns using Scrum methodology
- Created dummy web apps along with unit and integration tests using JUnit
- Created a web app which centralized the documentation for all modules in the web application
- Utilized Apache Maven, Apache Felix OSGi, Less.js, Handlebars.js, and Node.js

positions.title: Participant
positions.description:
- Completed technical exercises under the guidance of a Google engineer mentor
- Completed Udacity’s Developing Android Apps course
- Developed an app with 2 other students that gives information on recently released games
- Traveled to Google in Mountain View, CA for technical development and to present our app

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Met with application owners to define IT provided business services to measure up-time
- Setup and led meetings with engineers and architects to map out underlying IT components
- Used VBA to parse ticket data and calculate the overall up-time for business services

company.name: The Kansas City Southern Railway Company

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Researched recommender systems with a faculty mentor in the computer science department
- Developed the UI for a collaborative filtering recommender system for movies using Java

organizations.name: CoderDojo Manhattan
organizations.description: Our goal for this program is to expose young students to coding in a creative and informal environment where they are free to explore their interests. Whether they are brand new to coding and are interested in learning Scratch or maybe they have some experience and are interested in learning new web technologies, our mentors from the field will be there to help.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.position: Director of Engineering A Dream, Webmaster, Historian · Aug 2014 - May 2017
organizations.description:
- Redesigned our chapter’s website (https://www.k-state.edu/nsbe)
- Maintained the content on our website and take pictures at our events
- Organized an event called Engineering A Dream where middle school students come to K-State's campus for a full day of engineering activities. Increased attendance to 28 students which was 3x more than the previous year.
